verdict.rationale: The Core Ultra 9 285K is an unlocked desktop LGA1851 K-series CPU (36M cache, up to 5.70GHz) built for desktop gaming/creator rigs, not a mobile/ultrabook part; evidence even flags higher power consumption vs. AMD desktop rivals. Fanless, thin, all-day-battery laptop designs are a different product category (Intel's mobile Core Ultra U/H series), so this axis is a category error for this specific desktop SKU.
